committee.sub: Morning brief · Saturday 26 September 2026 · the committee’s read on the 7am numbers

items.text: Spend last 7 days sits at $117.46 against $181.21 prior, with clicks down to 21 from 28 and CPC at $5.59. Conversions remain at zero, and post restart clicks since 8 Sept stand at 62 of the 150 that would trigger the stop loss.
Impression share sits at just 10% over 30 days. Rank lost is 72.7% against budget lost of 22.5%, so the shortfall is an ad rank problem rather than a budget ceiling.

The calculator was used once in the last 7 days versus zero the week before, but form starts stayed at zero and /ai-automation-agency.html is still the heaviest landing page with 20 sessions of the 47 total.

AI Assistant sessions sit at 1 for the week, down from 2, with chatgpt.com the top source. That is likely an undercount since many AI referrals land in Direct with no referrer. LinkedIn also shows 1 session against 0 prior, consistent with Chris's recent posting.

actions.text: Logo and image assets plus keyword matched RSA headlines for the currently serving ad groups are still outstanding, get these finalised.
The homepage form still needs the confirm then count fix so kontrolTrackLead fires on the Formspree verdict rather than before it.
RSA description D1 still claims 13.3 hours of admin per week, update it to match current site stats.
